candidates.title: Visual baseline: save snapshots and compare
candidates.taskDescription:
## What to build

Let the user save a **baseline**: a snapshot of every current screen for the current URL. Later, a compare view shows each screen's baseline against the live page with a before/after slider.

Baselines are stored locally (per URL and per screen) and can be replaced or deleted.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Save baseline captures every screen for the current URL
- [ ] Compare view shows each screen with a draggable before/after slider
- [ ] Baselines persist across app restarts and can be updated or deleted
- [ ] Screens added after the baseline was taken are shown as "no baseline"

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately)

candidates.title: Add `kbom diff` to compare two KBOMs
candidates.taskDescription: Add a `kbom diff old.json new.json` command showing what changed between two snapshots: Kubernetes version, nodes, images, components and resource counts. Useful for drift detection, upgrade reviews and audit evidence. Support human-readable and JSON output.
